comparison.objective: Play a timed six-note phrase with two mallets; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual timed striking and rebound versus precise tool engagement, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Correct note order, hand alternation, 0.4–0.6 second gaps, and tool return; no dynamic-stop tuning.
comparison.reason: Timing and percussion accuracy are unrelated to damper adjustment despite both involving repeated physical actions.
